extraction_notes: DMN6075S-7 and DMN6075S-13 share the DMN6075S electrical data; this job is the -7 ordering variant.
The electrical-characteristics table publishes VGS(th) = 1 V minimum and 3 V maximum at VDS = VGS and ID = 250 uA; no typical threshold value is published.

The RDS(ON) table publishes typical values 69 mOhm at VGS = 10 V, ID = 3.2 A and 75 mOhm at VGS = 4.5 V, ID = 2.8 A, with corresponding maximum values 85 mOhm and 120 mOhm. The schema stores the typical value for each pair; maximum semantics are retained here because the schema has no second resistance field.
The output, transfer, body-diode, and Ciss/Coss/Crss curves were digitized from the published figures. Points are approximate grid read-offs with no interpolation between plotted points.
The transfer plot provides VDS = 5 V and temperature-separated curves; the 25 degC curve was retained. The output plot does not state temperature on the figure, so its temperature is not asserted.
Gate resistance, gate charge, switching times, thermal resistance, SOA, UIS, and temperature-dependence plots are not represented by fields in this extraction schema.

Correction retry: the p. 2 table lists Ciss = 606 pF, Coss = 32.6 pF, and Crss = 24.6 pF; scalar SI values are 6.06e-10 F, 3.26e-11 F, and 2.46e-11 F. Figure 10 is labeled pF; its digitized curve points are retained in SI F with the pF-to-F conversion.
